az_spread: *** WORST SPREAD SINCE GH #252 LANDED: 4 requested across 4 distinct AZs, 4 obtained, but only TWO DISTINCT AZs realized -- us-west-2c x3 and us-west-2d x1. THREE InsufficientInstanceCapacity refusals (2a once, 2b twice) drove two machines through `re-aiming inside the ring` and both landed on the SAME AZ, 2c, which is also where the machine that requested 2c went. GH #252's acceptance (>=2 distinct AZs) passes; GH #256's stricter one (4 distinct, no re-aiming) does NOT. Zero `AZ RING EXHAUSTED`, zero steps down the market ladder, all four spot. *** THE MECHANISM, which is worth more than the count: the ring walk is DETERMINISTIC and single-directional (a->b->c->d). Under region-wide capacity pressure every re-aimed call therefore converges on the same first-available AZ, so the placement decorrelation GH #252 bought is undone exactly in the regime it was bought for. #256 already found the one-hop version of this (a fallback landing on a just-cleared AZ); this is the multi-hop version, and it concentrated 3 of 4 machines. *** EXPOSURE, stated because the carrier gate makes it concrete: every carrier term sits at EXACTLY 2, and the three 2c machines carry crystal_maiden, lion, obsidian_destroyer, skeleton_king, spirit_breaker and zuus between them -- a single 2c capacity event would drop FIVE of the six terms to <=1 and obsidian_destroyer to 0. That is the W17 shape (four machines, one AZ, one event) at 3/4 strength. Filed as a [harness] issue this round; the desk does not change spot_run.sh itself.

reclaim_outcome: *** SEVENTH CONSECUTIVE WAVE BITTEN BY CAPACITY -- AND THE FIRST ONE WHERE THE BITE COST NOTHING. Seed 2740's machine (i-022ceff8ec8ab5827, us-west-2c) carries SIR code `instance-terminated-no-capacity` at 16:18:35Z. Read from the SIR alone, a round would write `one arm lost` and consider a re-run. THE CORPUS SAYS OTHERWISE: that machine delivered 48 games, exactly like the three clean ones, and its LAST game landed 16:00:43Z -- 17m52s BEFORE the reclaim. All four machines finished the identical 48-game programme and then sat ~15 minutes in the upload/drain phase; three self-terminated out of it (`instance-terminated-by-user` at 16:15:18 / 16:16:22 / 16:23:18Z) and 2740 was reclaimed during it. => NO re-run is owed, NO seed lost an arm, and W39 stands at 4 scored seeds / 168 games. *** THE GENERAL POINT, which is why this is written at length: the SIR code answers `how did this machine die`, NOT `did this machine deliver`. Those two questions came apart for the first time here, and the SIR-only reading fails toward SPENDING MONEY (a re-run of an already-complete seed) -- the same failure direction GH #429 names for reclaim_blind.py's yield count. Check the corpus before buying a re-run.
